# Jobs
Nanotrasen space stations have a large number of jobs, divided into seven main departments:
[bullet/][color=#1b67a5]Command[/color] consists of the station's Captain and the heads of every other department. They are collectively responsible for keeping the station and its departments running efficiently.
[bullet/][color=#b18644]Cargo[/color] is responsible for the station's logistics, acquiring resources for the station via purchase or salvage and distributing those resources to other departments.
[bullet/][color=#f39f27]Engineering[/color] is responsible for keeping the station powered, intact, and habitable, largely focusing on repairs and maintenance.
[bullet/][color=#5b97bc]Medical[/color] is responsible for the retrieval and treatment of injured and sick crew.
[bullet/][color=#c96dbf]Science[/color] is responsible for researching various otherworldly phenomena, and using that research to produce powerful new devices for the station.
[bullet/][color=#cb0000]Security[/color] is responsible for enforcing Space Law, and dealing with troublemakers and threats to the station.
[bullet/][color=#9fed58]Service[/color] is a diverse department that's collectively responsible for providing the crew with sustenance, sanitation, entertainment, and many other basic needs.
Aside from these seven main departments, there are also [color=#7f7f7f]Civilian[/color] members of the station who have no explicit responsibilities.
# Getting Your Job Changed The [color=cyan]Head of Personnel[/color] is generally in charge of changing ID accesses and handing out encryption keys. Head over to their office and let them know what job you'd like to work instead.
Often, they'll want you to go get a paper stamped by another member of Command. Don't sweat it, just find them and hand them the paper.
